id.description: The id of the silence to expire. Only silences dash created can be expired.

bearerAuth.description: A personal access token (dash_pat_..., Settings -> Tokens) or a static token of auth.tokens, for the api audience. A token reaches only the routes its scopes (x-dash-scope) allow, never one marked x-dash-interactive, and needs no X-Dash-Csrf or Origin. Sent together with the session cookie it is 400 ambiguous_credentials; an unknown, expired, revoked or mcp-audience token is 401 invalid_token. 300 requests a minute per token.

identityProxy.description: The user the identity proxy in front of dash authenticated. dash believes the header only from a TCP peer in auth.proxy.trustedProxies (X-Forwarded-For is never read), so a client cannot send it itself. Dev, demo and auth.mode none supply a fixed user.
identityProxy.name: X-Forwarded-Preferred-Username

sessionCookie.description: The session of auth.mode local (POST /login) and oidc (GET /auth/callback). The cookie is __Host-dash_session when server.publicURL is https and dash_session otherwise; HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax. A write also needs X-Dash-Csrf: 1 and the public Origin.
sessionCookie.name: __Host-dash_session

post.description: Runs only while the instance is running with actions.enabled set; otherwise 404. A call that passes the role, rate-limit, input and namespace checks is recorded in the audit log before it runs and again with its outcome. A refusal for role, rate limit or denied namespace is recorded as a denial (at most one per peer and reason a minute); a request with an invalid body (400) or for an unknown or unavailable action (404) is not recorded. Every call by a principal with the required role counts against the principal's action rate limit.
